verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for an incident-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never shows FireHydrant's platform source being published under an open license. The GitHub-hosted MCP server and its OpenAPI document are adjacent tooling with no stated license, not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
